# Sparkle

The brand symbol: a four-point star with concave sides. It means *achievement*: goal hit, streaks, personal bests, the moment the band buzzes its celebration pattern.

- Solid in `ink` or `accent-strong` on light grounds; `outlined` (a `line` stroke) whenever it sits in `accent` on `surface`, so a pastel star never floats without an edge.
- In the app, keep it rare: one per screen at most, and only for something earned. On packaging and the site it may scatter (the warp check), never more than one in five cells.
- Sizes: 12–16px inline, 24–32px in rings and badges, 56px+ for celebration moments. Minimum 12px.
- The canonical path is `Glint.SPARKLE_PATH` (100×100 box) and `assets/Brand/sparkle.svg`.
